items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Did you ever work with Sidney Duran? I did.

ctx.x: Bunk Johnson had another nice trombone player, Maurice Duran. He was a nice trombone player. Who did he play? He was away from me a long time too. He came back and I think he did some work with Sidney Duran after he came back here.
Did you ever work with Sidney Duran? I did. I did. I did.
I was awake there. Did you ever work up at the Tulane Alumni House on Willow Street? Yeah, I certainly did. on the Saturday. We were there on a Friday evening. I sure did.
